_comment: Project fidelity config for SPX mobile 交易明细 SPX screen (968:16532). Same tolerances as transfer-screen; status-bar text + repeated balance/fee numbers + repeated dates ignored.
_ignoreTextNote: Status-bar mock + repeated seed values (every card shows ±250.00 USD / 50.75 USD fee / 2026-05-25 15:07:40 / 20588***712 tx id). Em-dash is figma's '手续费 —' for exchange cards.

deviations.reason: Inner SVG vector subpaths inside iconography (back arrow, chevron-down, filter glyph, sort glyph, calendar glyphs, search glyph, copy glyph, bottom-nav glyphs, status-bar accessory, country flag). Each parent icon name is in iconDeviations (path-set waiver); inner Vectors are the same physical reason — impl renders each icon as a single inline SVG, not the figma-authored multi-vector composition. Approved 2026-05-29.

Inner group wrappers inside country-flag composition (united states). Impl renders the flag as a stylized inline SVG; figma authors the same glyph as Group+multi-Vector composition. Approved 2026-05-29.

Boolean-operation subnodes inside the bottom-nav 黑LOGO tab icon. Impl renders the brand monogram as a 3-stripe inline SVG; figma authors the same glyph as Subtract+Rectangle boolean ops. Approved 2026-05-29.
Group wrapper around the SPX brand monogram inside the bottom-nav 首页 tab. Impl renders the brand monogram inline; the figma group container has no impl analogue. Approved 2026-05-29.
Inner rectangle subpath inside the bottom-nav 黑LOGO boolean-op composition. Impl approximates the brand monogram as inline SVG strokes. Approved 2026-05-29.
